source: This separation is essential when interpreting performance counters. A residency metric cannot tell you which functional units were busy. A utilization metric based on “any kernel executing” cannot tell you whether the dominant pipeline was near peak. A throughput metric for one subsystem cannot tell you whether end-to-end application time was dominated by another subsystem.[3,4]
zh: 在解释性能计数器时，这种分离至关重要。驻留指标无法告诉您哪些功能单元繁忙。基于“任何内核执行”的利用率指标无法告诉您主要管道是否接近峰值。一个子系统的吞吐量指标无法告诉您端到端应用程序时间是否由另一个子系统主导。[3,4]
